description:
Stunning, fully furnished homes in West Dublin is now available for renting. 

Live in a growing community and enjoy easy access to recreation, education, local amenities and excellent transport links to Dublin City Centre.

Our homes at Adamstown are built to the highest standards and finished in signature Occu style. Modern frontages give way to smart, welcoming interiors - with all the home comforts our residents require. Featuring private gardens, houses at Occu Adamstown provide plenty of space for growing and established families alike.

Adamstown is a flourishing new neighbourhood in County Dublin. From local schools to sports facilities and green space, it's an idyllic base to make your home. Adamstown is a short drive from the conveniences of Lucan and Liffey Valley, and is just a 15 minute commute on the Kildare train Line from Dublin Heuston Station.

At Occu, we believe that renting should be better. That's why we're working hard to bring you the best: smarter, benefit focused and centred around the needs of our residents. No uncertainty, no hidden costs, stunning homes (and we'll let your pets move in too!).

Standard features of Occu Adamstown Houses include the following:
- Large open plan kitchen living areas
- Spacious living rooms
- Master ensuite and family bathroom
- Patio and garden
- Plenty of storage areas
- Excellent energy efficiency

Occu. Better Renting. That's different.
